--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -12,5 +12,31 @@
     tau_filter: float,
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
-
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # validation
+    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"), (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"), (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
+        if arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
+        if arr.size == 0:
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} is empty")
+        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
+        if (arr > 0).any():
+            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
+    if not (logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape == logp_with_result.shape):
+        raise ValueError("all input matrices must have the same shape")
+    # validate tau_filter
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, (bool, np.bool_)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
+    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.integer, np.floating)):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
+    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
+    if tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
+    # compute margin as reduction in loss compared to best baseline (no call or call only)
+    baseline = np.maximum(logp_no_call, logp_call_only)
+    margin = np.sum(logp_with_result - baseline, axis=1)
+    keep = margin >= tau_filter
+    return keep.astype(np.bool_), margin.astype(np.float64)
